entries.zh: 直话直说，毫无隐瞒；死直（「死」字加强语气，谓极其直率）
entries.en: to speak the truth plainly, hiding nothing; utterly forthright
entries.notes: R栏空白、M栏声调记号两处T99污损；西语尾部 comun bien 拼写费解，释义据首段西语与汉栏「死直」。

entries.zh: 有话直说、口快爽利；心直口快，藏不住话
entries.en: quick or frank of speech; to say outright whatever there is to say
entries.notes: 西语尾部以短横收束、语似未完，释义以汉栏「口快」为主。

entries.zh: 出言，开口说话、出一句话
entries.en: to utter a word; to speak out

entries.zh: 闲聊，说消遣解闷的话（首字存疑：字形或为「閒口」＝闲话；若为「閉口」则义为闭口不言，与西语相反）
entries.en: to chat idly, to pass the time with words (first character uncertain; possibly 閒口 'idle talk')
entries.notes: 汉栏首字录作「閉」且带[疑]记；西语 pasatiempo（消遣）指向闲谈义，故从闲谈。

entries.zh: 訛言，说假话、造谣；亦指以言语哄骗、讹诈他人财物
entries.en: to speak falsely, to spread rumors; to deceive or extort by words
entries.notes: 西语尾部 conuienden algo 拼写难解（疑为哄骗类动词），主体据汉栏「訛言」与音写栏定释义。

entries.zh: 两人和气交谈、语气相投；说话的和气态度
entries.en: to converse amicably together; a friendly tone of speech
entries.notes: 汉栏「語氣」本义为说话的语气，此处依西语 hablar dos amigablemente 取两人和气交谈义。

entries.zh: 原话，照前面说过的话原样复述、接前言说下去
entries.en: the original words; to repeat word for word what was said before, to speak in continuation of the foregoing
entries.notes: 西语缩写 consec⁹ 依推断展开（疑为 consecuencia／consecutivamente），据此定为照原话、接前言义。

entries.zh: 东拉西扯、到处乱说（字面「哮風狗」，如风狗乱吠、四处出声）
entries.en: to talk aimlessly here and there, roving from one thing to another (lit. a barking wind-dog yapping all around)
entries.notes: 首字带[疑:哮/呼]记；西语 rebolvo（revolver，翻搅、四处走动）喻说话东一句西一句。

entries.zh: 说话与先前不同、言语有出入（争差＝差别、争执）
entries.en: to speak differently from what was said before; discrepant speech

entries.zh: 说话，开口讲话（泛指；汉栏「咀争走」字面组合费解）
entries.en: to speak
entries.notes: 音写栏并录正反两种语序；西语仅作 hablar（说话），故从泛指义。

entries.zh: 先开口、起话头，头一个说话
entries.en: to speak first, to take the lead in talking

entries.zh: 谈笑，说笑闲聊、借谈笑消遣解闷
entries.en: to chat and laugh, to talk for amusement
entries.notes: 西语 entresenerse 拼写难解，疑为 entretenerse（消遣自娱）之误写，与汉栏「談笑」相合。

entries.zh: 讲话交谈，与人对话
entries.en: to speak, to converse
entries.notes: 首字「處」用法特殊（音写栏作 te），或为借字；整体依西语与「講話」定为交谈义。

entries.zh: 有条理地陈说，分条陈述、说话条理分明
entries.en: to speak methodically and in order, laying things out point by point
entries.notes: M栏第二声调记号T99污损；且第二字汉栏录「陳」而音写栏作 tit，与「陳」不谐，或为「條直」之误录，字形存异。

entries.zh: 泛言，泛泛而论、就整体笼统地说（不指名道姓）
entries.en: to speak in general terms, of the community at large

entries.zh: 音语不相同，言语互不相通、彼此对不上话（语音不同而无法沟通）
entries.en: to speak without coming to terms; speech not mutually intelligible

entries.zh: 音语相同，说同一种话、言语相通
entries.en: to speak the same language; mutually intelligible speech

entries.zh: 南北交加，南北口音夹杂、两种话混着说
entries.en: to speak two languages mixed together, southern and northern speech jumbled

entries.zh: 托熟，仗着熟人交情而攀谈、套近乎；与相熟之人交谈
entries.en: to speak on the footing of acquaintance, to presume on friendship; to talk with a friend

entries.zh: 话多、爱说话，言语絮烦（第二字恰/洽存疑）
entries.en: to talk much, to be talkative
entries.notes: 第二字带[疑:恰/洽]记；西语 hablar mucho 与汉栏「话…多」相合。

entries.zh: 说话颠三倒四、胡言乱语（如鲁，如鲁钝人般乱说）
entries.en: to talk wildly or incoherently, to ramble
entries.notes: 汉栏「如魯」字面「如鲁钝之状」，与西语 desvariando（胡乱而说）相合。

entries.zh: 私语，私下低声交谈、说悄悄话（西语残缺，作与某人单独私谈解）
entries.en: to whisper, to speak privately in secret (Spanish truncated: 'to speak alone with do…')
entries.notes: 西语词头于 do 处截断（[残]），依汉栏「私語」与音写栏定私谈义。
